details.description: The candidate composes the accepted 2026-07-31 Office mounted Agent files with the reviewed diagnostic overlay, and builds the Admin overlay from the deployed Admin Panel source baseline.

change_summary.expected_result: A replayable, privacy-safe diagnostic event index is prepared for LibreChat: bounded failure-only events, tenant-scoped Admin retrieval, stable Office classifications, and an Admin diagnostic-log interface. No production system is changed during candidate preparation.
functions: Preserve terminal initialization-failure persistence and Office pre-parse signal propagation
Record allowlisted diagnostic failure summaries with HMAC user correlation, tenant boundaries, TTL retention, bounded queue concurrency, and overflow rate limiting
Expose tenant-safe Admin list and detail routes under read:diagnostic_logs
Apply stable Office pre-parse error classifications without raw tool output
Compose the Admin diagnostic-log page from the deployed Admin source baseline
limitations: This candidate is a versioned source-and-replay artifact only: it contains no production preflight, backup, restart, deployment, or production acceptance evidence.

A unified production deployment runner is intentionally not included in the reviewed diagnostic source batch; a later deployment operation must be separately reviewed and approved before this candidate can be applied.

The focused backend test suite, overlay composition, Admin complete quality gate, and Sol review passed at the frozen revision; a full API Jest run remains unclaimed because an inherited integration timeout and Node heap ceiling prevented completion.
change_summary.reason: Provide privacy-safe evidence for diagnosing Office pre-parse failures, initialization persistence failures, and follow-up parent-saving conflicts without recording prompts, credentials, raw tool output, or stacks.
change_summary.risk: Enhanced: this candidate affects the API, Admin Panel, Office pre-parse error path, diagnostic collection indexes, permissions, and tenant isolation. Candidate preparation performs no production write.

details.method: Before any later apply, capture the active Compose override, exact API mount sources, and Admin image/container identifiers; restore those sources and recreate only LibreChat-API and LibreChat-Admin-Panel if post-write checks fail.
details.non_destructive_data_behavior: Do not drop diagnostic_events during rollback. The collection is TTL-bounded and the prior API simply stops writing or reading it.
details.stop_condition: Do not deploy until the versioned runner proves its backup and protected-service invariants in a fresh read-only target preflight.

validation_plan.expected: Privacy allowlist, credential redaction, tenant boundary, bounded writer behavior, and correlation tests pass.
The 2026-07-31 mounted Agent contract, diagnostic overlay, Admin permission boundary, and patched Office error codes compose without regressing initialization persistence.
Backend, Admin, Office, and source-manifest replay results match the recorded base and result hashes.

validation_plan.command: Admin complete quality gate at frozen revision
validation_plan.expected: Pinned source hash, locale parity, Prettier/import baselines, lint, typecheck, Vitest, and production build pass.
Governance config, 34 release-governance tests, Skill validation, and whitespace checks pass.
